تتبحبحي (form IIq)
# تَتَبَحْبَحِي (tatabaḥbaḥī) /ta.ta.baħ.ba.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
# تُتَبَحْبَحِي (tutabaḥbaḥī) /tu.ta.baħ.ba.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of تَبَحْبَحَ (tabaḥbaḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
